subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed in-app orders for {Brand} in the metros where you fulfill. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed first order, the real paid order from a new install, and we control spend by store density so budget lands inside your live delivery zones. At scale that runs around 6,000 completed orders a day, the throughput Wingstop and Chipotle look for when judging a source. Worth a short look at the zone-level read?
angle: warm bump, restate completed first-order proof
illustrative_flags: 6,000 completed orders a day (MobUpps daily completed-order volume, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN food_and_delivery: references prior in first sentence; restates single proof (completed first in-app order + store-density targeting); one illustrative MobUpps figure (6,000 orders/day); QSR peers Wingstop, Chipotle reused from parent; soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
